extracted.name: Spicy Southwestern Slaw
extracted.description: This is a spicy, flavorful coleslaw speckled with diced jalapenos, red bell pepper and cilantro.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, carrot, onion, red pepper, jalapeno and cilantro. Set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, sugar, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour.
